segments.text: Hey everyone! Batch 1 mein hum travelling allowance yani TA ki basics aasan hinglish mein sikhenge.
TA, official duty ke liye honewali travel costs se joda hai. Ye har personal trip ka paisa nahi hai.
Maan lo, Delhi ka ek employee office inspection ke liye Jaipur jata hai.
Approved trip par rules ke hisaap se TA chek hoga.
Lekin, wahi employee family ke saath weekend trip kare, toh wo official tour nahi hai.
Ikor important baat, TA aur LTC same nahi hai. Central Government Civilian TA ke orders
Department of Expenditure deta hai. LTC aur service rules ke liye DOPT ki guidelines
bhi chek karen. Example, official training ki trip aur chutti mein hometown jaane ka claim
do alag cases hai. Railway aur armed forces ke liye alag orders bhi ho sakti hai. Isliye
apni service ke rules zaroor chek karen.
Updates ki baat, main TA order 13 July 2017 ko issue hoa.
Likin changes, 1st July 2017 se effective thay.
Maanlu trip 30 June ko khatm hoa. Purane rules chek honge.
2 July wale trip ke liye new rules se shuru kare.
Matlab issue date aur effective date ek nahi hai.
Ab old entitlement wali safety cheq. Agar newa order kisi individual ya group ki pehle se
mili travel klas ya mode ko kum krta hai toh saving clause ki hisaap se purani higher entitlement
jari rahiti hai. Japtak normal course me usse higher entitlement na mili. Example, kisi
officer ki purani approved klas new table se better thi. Toh office se saving clause
aur purani proof chek karain. Iska matlab har employee ko automatic upgrade nahi milta.
TA ki entitlement pay level setai hoti hai. Pay level aur pay amount same cheez nahi hai.
2017 order me pay in the level ka matlab matrix wale level ka basic pay hai. NPA, MSP ya special
pay iss mein nahi jordte. Manlub basic pay 50,000 rupees hai aur NPA 10,000.
Is definition me pay 50,000 hi hai, 60,000 nahi.
Ab ek aur example, level 7 employee apna travel class level 6 to 11 wali row mein chek karega.
Likin hurt ye component ka calculation alag hosakta hai.
Sirf travel class wali table dekkar transfer grant ka amount decide mat kariye.
Us component ki conditions alag chek hongi.
Official tour or training mein, domestic travel ke liye pay level se class thai hoti hai.
Level 14 aur upar, business ya club air, ya train mein AC first.
Level 12 aur 13, economy air ya AC first dekhenge.
Example, level 13 E ko TA aur daily allowance mein level 13 jaya sa treatment milta hai.
Sirf A honi se business class nahi milti.
Trip ka approval aur booking rules bhi zaroori hai.
Level 6 to 11, economy air ya train mein AC second. Level 5 on niche, first class AC third
ya AC chair carbide train. Example, level 7 employee approved official tour par economy
flight ki entitlement raksakta hai. Lekin level 6 to 8 ke liye ordinary LTC mein vahi
air entitlement nahi hoti. Kuch special LTC schemes alag ho sakti hai. Toh tour aur
LTC ko mix mat kariye.
Kuch premium trains ke liye alak table hai. List mein Rajdhani, Shatabdi, Duronto, Premium,
Premium Tatkal aur Suvidha hai. Level 12 aur upar Executive ya AC first, level 6-11 AC
second ya Shatabdi chairkar aur level 5 vaniche AC third ya chairkar chek karte hai.
Example, level 7 ka employee Shatabdi mein apni chair kaar entitlement chek karega.
Executive class assume nahi karega.
Premium tatkal charges aur Shatabdi Rajdhani Duronto ki dynamic ya flexi fare ke liye order
ka exact wording dekhhi.
Fixed fare, tatkal sewa charges bhi jari hi hai.
Example, eligible Shatabdi ticket par dynamic fare claim karte sa me order ki conditions
chek karein.
Up 2023 ka train update. Tejas aur Vande Bharat ki entitlement Shatabdi jaisi aur Hamsafar ki Rajdhani jaisi hai.
Ye mapping, tour, training, transfer aur retirement wali listed journeys par chek hoti hai. Example, level 7 employee approved Vande Bharat tour ke li Shatabdi wali chair card chek kareega.
Hamsafar ke li Rajdhani wali class dikhega. Train ka naam executive class ka automatic pass nahi hai.
Jab 2 jagahe rail se connected nahi hai, to AC second aur upper ki train entitlement wale
employees ko AC bus ki chhout hai. Baaki log deluxe ya ordinary bus chek karen. Example,
level 7 ko aise destination par jaana hai, jaha rail connection nahi hai, wo baaki conditions
ke saath AC bus dek sakta hai. Ye rule poori taxi ya road mileage table nahi hai.
Agar donu jaga hi real se connected hain to public road transport allowed hain.
Paar total fare aapke entitled train fare se zyada nahi hona chahiye.
Example, bus fare 900 aur entitled train fare 1000 rupi hain to hi fare condition poori hain.
Baki checks abhi bhi zaroori hain.
Aur maan lul level 7 ki AC second seat nahi milti, iss rule mein lower class mein jaasakte hain.
Higher class ka automatic upgrade nahi milta.
Government account se air ticket book karne ho, to is order mein 3 approved agents hai, Balmalori, Ashok Travels & Tours aur IRCTC.
Example, level 7 employee air travel ke liye eligible hosakta hai, likin ticket booking aur tour approval bhi chek honge.
Best available fare apne entitle klas aur fixed 3 hour slot mein chek kare.
Convenience ke liye order ka 10% price band bhi dekhe. Example, 10 a.m. flight ke liye 9-12
wala slot dekhe. Koi rolling window nahi. Ye air ticket rule hai. Ise, her rail ticket
par automatically mat lagain. Unavoidable case mein limited relaxation ka process guide mein.
Tuvar aur LTC ke liye 21 days pehle flight book karna encouraged hai.
Isse har kis mein mandatory deadline mat maaniye.
Tuvar booking departure se less than 72 hours pehle ho, to employee ko apna reason deena hota hai.
Example, urgent tour ki ticket doh din pehle book hui to self-declared reason ready rakhe.
Usi trip ke baat 72 hours ke andar required journey completion certificate ne.
Ye booking reason se alag hai.
Government account ke air travel par mileage points generate nahi hu nahi chahiye.
Tour, transfer, or training card, TA claim, normally journey khatm hu ne ke baat 60 days me submit karna hota hai.
Late hu ne par claim forfitted, yani lost maana jaa sakta hai.
Example, journey 1st October 2026 ko khatm hu hi, to 2nd October day 1 hai aur 30th November day 60.
Correct office me time par submit kari aur proof rakhi.
Retirement TME 2021 order ne limit 180 days after journey kardi, 2 transfer or training
ke liye 60 days rehte. Example, eligible retirement journey 1st October
2026 ko khatm ho, to 180th day 30th March 2027 hai.
Yad rakh hi, trip karne ki eligibility period aur clean file karne ki deadline alag baate
purani unsettled cases par review ki possibility guide me hai.
Transfer me agar employee aur family alag alag travel karte hain, to har journey ke rie clean clock alag shuru hota hain.
Example, employee 1st October aur family 11th October ko pohchhi, to dono ki completion date alag count hogi.
Personal effects ya conveyance ke liye new station par actual delivery ki date alag check karein.
Claim when submit maana jayega, ye is baat par bhi depend karta hai ki aap apne controlling
officer hud hai ya nahi. Agar nahi, to head of office ya controlling officer ko submission
deed dekhain. Agar aap apne controlling officer hai, treasury ya cash section me presentation
deed dekhain. Example, aapne controlling officer ko day 45 par claim dia. Aur treasury
ko baad me mila, to order ki conditions ke saath pehle wali submission deed matter
kar sakti hai. Receipt ya acknowledgement sambhal kar rakhain.
Quick official update. Boarding pass missing ho to kya karein?
DOE ka 2020 order central government ki official tour journey ke liye hai.
Agar physical aur digital copy dono nahi hai to prescribed self-declaration TA bill ke saath de sakte hai.
Example, level 9 employee apna pas kho deta hai.
Wo actual journey, PNR aur no double claim ki details declaration mein deta hai.
Level 10 aur niche ki employees ko controlling officer se declaration counter-sign karaana hai.
Ye lost pass declaration Johnny Completion Certificate se alag hai.
June 2022 order mein Completion Certificate Johnny ke 72 hours ke andar mangah gaya hai.
TA bill alag rule se baad me submit huta hai.
Example, employee flight ke baat completion certificate bheechta hai.
Boarding pass nahi mila to bil ke saath alag prescribe declaration lagata hai.
False declaration pa disciplinary action aur recovery ho sakti hai.
Official tour per local travel ki reimbursement, actual expense aur baaki conditions par depend karti hai.
DOE ke 2020 clarification ne pay level 9-11 ke liye city travel vouchers ki condition hatai.
Lekin self-certification mein travel period aur vehicle number jaisi details deeni hai.
Example, level 10 employee official visits ki liye cab leeta hai.
Receipt nahi hai to wo sahi expense aur vehicle number self-certify karta hai.
Applicable limits aur baki checks abhi bhi zaruni hai.
Free boarding aur lodging milne par bhi, tour ke liye genuinely incurred local travel applicable
rules ke hasaap se claim ho sakta hai. Example, Trini ko free hotel aur meals mile, lakin
official local trip ka allowed kharch khut diya. Woh us kharch ko rules aur evidence ke saath
chek kareega.
Level 9-11 ki ye voucher relaxation, hotel, food, transfer ya LTC ke har claim par automatikli lagu nahi hoti.
Ab DOPT ki 1 July 2025 wali LTC FAQ se kuch important differences.
Eligible family members alak travel kar sakte hain.
Agar sir family LTC par jaare hi hai, employee ko sirf us wajah se leave lene ki zoroorat nahi hain.
Example, employee office me kaam karta hai aur eligible family member approved LTC pa jata hai.
Lekin employee hooth LTC le, to admissible leave zaroori hai.
Sirf weekend ya holiday kaafi nahi hai.
Ye official tour TA ka rule nahi hai.
DOPTFAQ ke mutabik, LTC mein incidental aur local journey kharch kawar nahi hote.
Ghar se airport ka local taxi fare bhi LTC mein nahi hai.
Example, family holiday ke liye ghar se airport jaane ki cab us LTC claim mein madh jodiye.
Official tour par local travel ki alak konditions hosakti hai. Dono systems ko mix mat kariye.
DOPT ki 2025 FAQ ke anusar, Tejas, Vande Bharat aur hum suffer se LTC travel entitlement ke
hisaab se allowed hai. Example, employee pehle LTC ki entitled class chek krta hai. Sirf train
ke naam se executive class assume nahi krta. Flight ko 21 days pehle book karna encouraged
hai. FAQ isi harki iski automatic four feature deadline nahi banati. Agar office ka karenge
If there is no official email, then for LTC, in FAQ, the office has given a way to register
through details to the authorized agent. Example, the required details of the office
and the private email to the agent. This is a specific answer for LTC.
Check the rules of the tour separately. FAQ also states that the old LTC ET fair
scheme is not present now. Verify the validity of a special relaxation from the
booking.
Important correction – LTC ke har air ticket par 3 agents ki requirement ek jaisi nahi hai.
DOPT ki 2023 instruction 2025 guidelines me bhi dihi gai hai.
Jo employee ordinary LTC me air entitled nahi hai, phir bhi apni marzi se flight lay aur special dispensation use nahi karta
uske liye 3 agents se hi ticket lena mandatory nahi hai.
Example, level 7 employee ordinary LTC par flight chunta hai toh iss specific exception ko check karenge.
Reimbursement, actual airfare aur shortest route ki entitle train ya bus fare me jo kam ho
us tak limited hai. Example, flight 8000 rupees aur eligible rail fare 5000 ho, to 5000 ki
ceiling check hogi, baaki conditions alak check karein. Valid special dispensation ke tahan
non-air entitle flight ke liye authorised agents ki alag requirement hai. Scheme ki current
validity aur cancellation rules bhi pehile verify karein.
LTC claim ki clock, official tour TA se alag hai.
DOPT FAQ ke mutabek, advance liya ho to return journey ke baat ek month ke andar claim de.
Advance nahi liya ho to return journey ke baat 3 month ke andar claim de.
Example, bina advance wala employee return ki date note karke 3 month me LTC bill submit karta hai.
Isi tour TA ke 60 days se confuse mat kariye.
Late LTC claim automatically approve nahin hota. FAQ mein department aur financial advisor
ki konkarin se limited relaxation di gayi hai. Without advance wale case mein 6 months tak
aur advance wale case mein 3 months tak ki stated limits hai. Advance wale case mein poora
advance aur prescribed penal interest refund ki condition bhi hai. Example, late claim
mein employee reason aur documents deta hai aur competent authority se decision mangta
hai. Extra time ko automatic right nahin samajhta.
Technical resignation ke liye DOPT ke 2022 consolidated order ko dekhayin.
Proper channel se government post ke liye apply kiya, selection hui aur administrative
reason se resignation dena pada to stated conditions par wo technical ho sakta hai.
Example, employee approved channel se 2stri government post me select hota hai
aur required resignation deta hai. Past service ya baaki benefits alag rules ke conditions
per depend krte hai. Har resignation ko technical bol deni se benefits automatic nahi banti.
Usi order ke paragraph 3.6.3 me, open competition ya interview se central government post par appointment ka specific transfer tiyay rule hai.
Usme temporary central government employee ki regular continuous service, 3 saal se kum ho to transfer tiyay nahi milta.
Permanent ya provisionally permanent state employee ke liye bhi paragraph ki alag wording dekhain.
Example, temporary central employee ki asi service doh saal hai, toh wo is stated exclusion mein
aata hai. Baaki cases mein appointment aur service status check karna zarudi hai.
Retirement composite transfer grant, i.e. CTG ke liye DOE ka 6th January 2022 ka amendment
important hai. Retirement ke baat settlement mein 20 kilometer wali condition hatai gai.
Lekin residence ka actual change aur prescribed declaration zaluri hai.
General rate last month's basic pay ka 80% hai, baaki applicable conditions ke saath.
Example, last basic pay Rs. 50,000 ho to eligible full CTG Rs. 40,000 banta hai.
Order apni issue date se effective hai.
Andamanin Nikobar ya Lakshwadeep island territory se ya vaha qualifying settlement par order ke
mutabik CTG last basic pay ka 100% hai, applicable terms ke saath. Example, eligible island ke
isme 50,000 basic pay par is rate se 50,000 rupees chek honge.
Retirement journey ka TA claim normally journey ke baad 180 days mein dihani wali rule, move
karni ki eligibility period se alag hai.
Agar TA claim ek saal se zyada abayans, yani pending rakh ha gaya hai, head of department ko
isse investigate karna chahiye. Example, long pending claim mein tickets, papers aur delay
ka reason de. Department genuineness aur valid reasons chekk karke baaki formal cheks karega.
Iska matlab har late claim automatically approve hoga, aisa nahi hai.
Batch 1 mein humne B6, domestic travel, booking, claim deadlines aur kuch verified FAQ aur amendments dekhhe.
Example, level 7 ka trainee flight leneh se pehle entitlement aur booking chekk kanega
aur trip ke baat certificate aur clean ki deadline.
Daily allowance aur road rates ke full tables, transfer, retirement aur technical resignation
ki baaki konditions agi ke batches mein ainggi. Complete course abhi finish nahi hua hai. Detailed
examples aur official source links saath wale guide mein hai. Thanks for watching.
